answer: The quarry face stands sheer in the morning light, and the quarryman works the rock with plug and feather. Proof of quarryman via stone block tally — a block the quarryman squares only after 29 blocks sit true without one cracking at the face, each squared by the quarryman himself. cipher drills the holes and sets the feathers in a row. yarrow taps the plugs till the stone splits clean. ferrous squares the block with the hammer and the square. Twenty-nine blocks must sit true without one cracking at the face, and the next still cracks where the stone ran flawed.
